main_issue: How D can keep cooking strong-smelling sambal belacan without the smell bothering A (living room), B (bedroom) and C (laundry); settled on Tue/Thu after 7pm, window open, B's door closed.

A-B.evidence: Both complain about smell (T1, T2); B's door-closing idea (T8) is not opposed by A, and B ends up accepting the Tue/Thu after 7pm plan with window and door closed (T26).

A-C.evidence: A rejects C's Mon/Wed/Fri idea as insufficient for the living room (T12), but A's after-7pm request combines with C's days into the Tue/Thu plan (T19-21).

A-D.evidence: D resists A's ban (T4, T6, T15); then agrees to cook after 7pm (T17), and on Tue/Thu (T20), which fits A's request (T16).

B-C.evidence: C says B's door idea does not help the laundry (T9), B concedes (T10); B later backs C's days-and-time deal (T18-21) and is satisfied by the window and door fix (T26).

B-D.evidence: D initially dismisses complaints (T4); B says the time plan doesn't help her room (T18, T23); D offers to open the window and B accepts if she closes her door (T25-26).

C-D.evidence: D initially resists (T4); C proposes Mon/Wed/Fri avoidance (T11), D accepts Tue/Thu (T20), C confirms 'that works' (T21).
